digest.component_or_area: Jira write dispatch and retry budget
propositions: Jira writes across Cloud ACLI/REST and DC SDK can cross multiple retry boundaries, causing timeout-multiplied writes or ambiguous acceptance; a single provider-neutral retry budget with exact postcondition observation is needed to establish deterministic behavior

A constructor-injected executor selector must route selected exact summary-only writes to a dedicated Cloud ACLI or DC SDK handler, defaulting to legacy and adding no config surface, with no dual-send or mixed-field splitting

Each selected write operation must not exceed three physical invocations, 15 seconds cumulative sleep, and an exponential backoff schedule [2s,3s) then [4s,5s), with provider Retry-After as a lower bound and permanent/auth/permission failures using one invocation

DC write invocations must execute exactly GET→PUT→GET with no hidden repeats; ambiguous PUT requires a separate GET observation; successful read-back is authoritative; over-budget provider delay returns retry_not_before without sleeping

Cloud recovery must use primary-store REST get_issue_by_rest with one attempt and no sleep; DC wrapper calls must use one-attempt/no-sleep policies; all other callers retain current retry behavior and defaults

Every terminal outcome must emit exactly one redacted completion log with logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, retry_not_before, and one redacted message capped at 512 Unicode code points; operation outcomes hold at most eight redacted diagnostics each capped at 512 code points
